column3: crest jewels of the greatest serpents
the story, very wondrous, steadfast in yoga
the form of an incarnation as a fish
the sages are sparing of speech
in the midst of a crowd of sages and best kings
having the nature of a sage
the kinsmen killed, given to grief by the sages
from the sage, Vyasa's son, this
with mind fixed on the feet of Murari
rushed to take what was dead
in battle by the weapons of many great chariot-warriors
attached to the pleasure of sex
about to sacrifice with the horse sacrifice
shares of the sacrifice and so on
like the sun, the rainbow and lightning
as in a cluster of lotuses
by one who meditates on whom
those whose minds are cleared by whose power
which was experienced, O descendant of Ajamidha
the unmanifest which spreads out unexpanded qualities
the loss of what is untrue
when the body of the Self is playing
when he saw the Self as refuge
which is subject to the Lord
in the ocean of the Yadu clan, the first, friend of Ananta
the praise of the qualities of the one of excellent fame
befitting the qualities of the one of excellent fame
to the king of the Yadus
of the best of the Yadus
than that obtained by chance, I
by whose fault one goes down
above and below those who wander
as the great eat the small
in Vasudeva, Lord of all worlds
living by the prosperity of whose arms
as I was giving up my life
by whom (they) were freed, they led
when, O lotus-eyed, he went away
by the arrangements of whose limbs
having made him perform horse sacrifices
as long as the Lord here
of one who unites the mind
mixing of the rules of the ages
at the change of the yuga
at the juncture of the yuga
by which the supreme intelligence called liberation (is gained)
yogis desire the northern course, willingly dying
by yoga, with all watches of the night filled
by the qualities of rajas, sattva and tamas
full of the Ratna/jewels? (Ratambhara, filled with truth)
we, O dear one, ... the disc-bearer
with chariots, horses, elephants and foot-soldiers
having obtained the husband of Rama (Lakshmi)
the sky bright as the sun's rays
of the dwellers of the lower worlds
O king, of what you asked
powerful to destroy the clan of kshatriyas, not salvation
adorned with the best royal chariot-circles
for the sake of the king
the royal sage who performed the horse sacrifice
lament over the birth and deeds of the royal sage
of Rama's incarnation? (of the king's incarnation)
the sacrifice (Yajna) was born of Ruchi
voice halted in the choked throat, speech faltering
with groups of planets, stars and constellations
would not wish to give up
of those embraced by creepers' limbs
with graceful gait, play and sweet laughter
of one who has found taste, O great sage
shining with Shri, mixed with tulasi
with the tip of the plough
being dissolved into nature, without qualities, no mark, impossible
acts of the lineage and so on
with hair scattered on the face
slaying of the calf and Baka
adorned with a grove of jujube/badari trees
in the form of a kinsman
face-lotus surrounded by locks of hair
from the best giver of boons
in the form of a boon
ten thousand times ten thousand years
by the powerful great Yadus others (were conquered)
wrinkles, grey hair, old age and so on
by beautiful voice, syllables and parts in the mind
girdle on the hips, with trembling pitcher-like breasts and heavy braids
